_doc: Stills models for remote_stills_*.py, chosen by shots_to_jobs.py --model. Owner's rule (2026-11-25): step-distilled 'turbo' models are for drafts and layout only, never for anything that ships; their stills are stamped draft and render refuses them. 'default' is the model shots_to_jobs.py uses without --model. Every model here has commercially usable weights, with the licence read from its model card on the date given. full_gpu_gb, when set, is the card memory at which the whole pipeline goes on the GPU; below it the model loads one component at a time (default 1.5 x min_vram_gb). Excluded for licence: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev (non-commercial). offload 'sequential' moves one layer at a time onto the card when the pipeline doesn't fit whole (slowest, least memory). route 'codex' is not a Colab model: scripts/codex_stills.py makes its stills on the Mac.
default_note: Provisional. The 2026-11-25 bake-off winner is chatgpt-image-codex, which waits on the owner's yes (it spends his Codex allowance); Qwen-Image 2512's sequential-offload retry is pending.

z-image.licence: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face model card cardData.license, read by the Mac 2026-11-25). Full model; Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo is the distilled one.
z-image.bakeoff: L4 bake-off 2026-11-25: 155-215 s per still with model offload; still gets object structure wrong (seat on a pedestal, drawn border, melted hand truck).

qwen-image-2512.licence: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face model card cardData.license, read by the Mac 2026-11-25).
qwen-image-2512.card_note: A100 80 GB for the whole pipeline on the card; below 70 GB it needs sequential offload (the plain model offload moves the 40 GB transformer onto the card at once and ran out of memory on an L4, 2026-11-25). Sequential offload on an L4 is untested, so min_vram_gb stays 40 until it is.

chatgpt-image-codex.licence: OpenAI terms: the user owns the output and may use it commercially; files carry OpenAI's C2PA provenance, kept in the untouched originals.
chatgpt-image-codex.bakeoff: 2026-11-25 winner on anatomy, scale, night skies and no garbled text: 9 stills in about 6 min via codex exec. Faults: a face in 3 of 5 hero shots, 2 of 9 at an odd aspect (both now re-rolled by codex_stills.py).
chatgpt-image-codex.note: Spends the owner's Codex allowance; not the default until he says yes.
